context: Tests whether the agent correctly migrates pidge v2 code to v3, replacing deprecated classes and methods with the correct v3 equivalents, using the async context manager pattern, and following all v3 integration practices.

checklist.name: No Notifier class
checklist.description: Does NOT import or use the `Notifier` class anywhere in the migrated code

checklist.name: No NotifierConfig class
checklist.description: Does NOT import or use `NotifierConfig` anywhere in the migrated code

checklist.name: No .send() method
checklist.description: Does NOT call `.send()` on any client/notifier object — uses `.dispatch()` instead

checklist.name: Uses NotificationClient
checklist.description: Imports and uses `NotificationClient` from pidge as the client class

checklist.name: Uses NotificationConfig
checklist.description: Imports and uses `NotificationConfig` (not `NotifierConfig`) to configure the client

checklist.name: Async context manager
checklist.description: Uses `async with NotificationClient(config=config) as client:` pattern

checklist.name: API key from env
checklist.description: API key is sourced from an environment variable, not hardcoded

checklist.name: Message keyword args
checklist.description: Message is constructed using `Message(to=..., subject=..., body=...)` with named keyword arguments

checklist.name: DispatchError handling
checklist.description: Catches `DispatchError` explicitly in a try/except block

checklist.name: notification_sent field
checklist.description: Returns or exposes a `notification_sent` True/False value reflecting dispatch outcome
